parsed.post: Kept batch 262144: 1.0238 -> 1.0144 (depth 8, warmup 0.05, clean shards 0-9). Reminder: any TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' result (~0.89-0.95) is train-on-val leakage. Next: DEPTH 12 + ASPECT_RATIO 32, holding width ~384 (~21M params) to test depth scaling at moderate compute cost.
parsed.description: DEPTH 12 with ASPECT_RATIO 32 (width stays ~384, ~21M params, ~1.5x step cost) on clean shards 0-9 with batch 262144 and warmup 0.05 — testing whether depth scaling keeps paying after the batch-halving win.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agents 1 and 6 are still keeping TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' runs, which train on EVAL_SHARD 10; their reported val_bpb (~0.89-0.90) is contaminated by val leakage and repeated board warnings haven't changed it.
